title: Managed Database: database service meters
content:
## Governing clause
Managed Database database service meters applies to database charge, database supplemental meter, database service record. Each primary node has vCore count cores, memory in GiB memory and included storage GB per node. Primary standard node-hours use standard unit rate. Configuration high availability multiplies primary node rate by high availability multiplier; configuration replica uses read replica multiplier, mutually exclusively. commercial engine license separately bills actual vCore-hours at commercial license rate; the configuration or engine entitlement does not waive that license. storage bills provisioned GB-month beyond included storage GB per node at storage rate. iops bills provisioned IOPS-month beyond included IOPS at IOPS rate. backup storage bills GB-month retained beyond included native retention days at backup storage rate, with the export separating retention segments; restoration itself is not counted as storage. restore bills restored GB at restore rate. Included native retention is not multiplied by the number of restores. Nodes stopped for a suspended contract produce no running node-hours but still accrue retained storage. The following former clause is no longer in force: “Managed Backup is a separately held protection service and never automatically overrides native database retention or license pricing.” For every ancillary meter, multiply the nonincluded measured quantity by its selected rate, then round the net line using monetary decimal precision and rounding convention and tax under tax calculation. An allowance is consumed chronologically by service interval start then original source reference within the named holding and UTC period; reversal of its source returns only that source allocation. Source subtype supplemental identifies these amounts so the primary discount policy does not apply. Completed service records prove nonfinancial entitlements; unknown meter codes or units are outside policy coverage instead of guessed prices. These calculations never authorize an unapproved customer-only action. For included capacities denominated in GB-month, contact-month or package-month, prorate the capacity by actual active interval seconds divided by actual seconds in its UTC month before comparing measured quantity. Category-specific primary inclusions replace the generic included quantity where expressly named; they are not added twice. A mandatory minimum fee is a pricing minimum, not a second charge.

## Ancillary amount treatment
For an ancillary charge, determine the nonincluded measured quantity, multiply it by the selected ancillary rate, round that net line using the monetary precision and rounding convention, and apply tax. Chronological allowance allocation stays within the named contract and UTC period. A reversal restores only its originating allocation.

## Restore-count case
Hypothetical condition case: a database has one restore instead of several restores. Changing only the number of restores does not multiply its included native retention, because the clause expressly excludes restore-count multiplication.

superseded_clauses: Managed Backup is a separately held protection service and never automatically overrides native database retention or license pricing.
